BL-754 — take-flow-reason's single-quote and unquoted branches are completely untested - an unquoted comma does not merely truncate a reason, it silently drops the next stage entirely
What it solves: BL-723 hardener verdict on BL-661: not-on-par (independent finding; the
three prior seats read the "real parsing hazard (quoted reasons
containing commas and braces)" as covered and only noted the unrelated
scenario-05 wiring gap as a nit).
Linked pilot-process defect: BL-755.
Approval context: One decision to confirm, and a recommendation rather than an open fork. The originating note left it undecided between rejecting unquoted comma-bearing values and requiring quoting at the schema level. The contract as written takes a third, narrower route: keep parsing best-effort, never throw, and…
BL-754 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-754" (or "reject BL-754 <reason>") to act.
